intro.text: A chromium Misting, or Leecher, and one of the women held captive by the Set.

items.text: Macil was seized by the Vanishers and handed over to the Set to live in its Community. The Set told her she had been picked by random lottery to be spared a catastrophic ashmount eruption.

When Armal used Rioting to inflame Gave Entrone's shame, Macil stripped away his metals by Leeching, leaving Armal free to tie him up. She was among the Wayfarer Allomancers who helped Marasi drain the perpendicularity, and after they had rested, Marasi led them out of the caverns into Bilming.
